title: prepare_verification input
description: Prepares a verification recipe without running anything (FR043): pins the snapshot, argv, working directory, environment allowlist, limits and expiry into a binding a person must approve with `proofmesh verification approve <id>` and run with `proofmesh verification run <id>`. Refused unless a person enabled verification execution for this data directory.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

command.description: The exact argv to run, from the workspace's working directory.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the disposable workspace.

env_allow.description: Environment variables passed through from the launcher's environment; everything else is dropped. PATH always passes.

expires_in_s.description: How long the approval may be given and used; default 900.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.
